claims: "The Big Dance" is a nickname for the annual NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament.
The annual NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is also known as March Madness.
The NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is a 68-team single-elimination tournament.
The NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is held in the United States.
The NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament determines the national champion.
Former Marquette coach Al McGuire coined the phrase "the big dance" in 1977.
When asked about wearing a lucky blazer to the tournament, former Marquette coach Al McGuire replied, "Absolutely. You gotta wear the blue blazer when you go to the big dance.".
Al McGuire referred to the NCAA tournament as the ultimate event in college basketball.
Selection Sunday for the 2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is March 15, 2026.
The First Four for the 2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is March 17–18, 2026.
The First Round for the 2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is March 19–20, 2026.
The Final Four for the 2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament is April 4 and 6, 2026, in Indianapolis, Indiana.
The 2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament field comprises 68 teams, including automatic qualifiers from conferences and at-large bids.
The "First Four" games involve the final four at-large teams and the lowest-seeded conference champions fighting to enter the round of 64.
The Women's NCAA tournament features a "Big Dance."
